verdict.rationale: YPOG's notary-services downloads page offers free public forms for incorporation, including a GmbH/UG foundation questionnaire and a 'Starterkit GmbH-foundation', plus AML/KYC questionnaires. These cover the incorporation part of the story as downloadable prep material rather than finished documents. Its SAFE and convertible content is educational briefings, not templates, and there is no evidence of NDAs or interactive document generators. Missing for 10: SAFE/term sheet templates, NDA templates, document generators, actual incorporation document templates (beyond questionnaires and a starter kit), explicit confirmation that non-clients can use them freely.
